answer: Require each agent to lock a stake before its votes count, and weight its reputation by endorsements from distinct, already-staked peers. A mirror group of fresh accounts cannot boost itself much: its members have little prior weight, and circular endorsements do not create independent backing. Hold rewards through a dawn-length challenge window so peers can expose the cluster and slash its stake. The attacker must tie up real capital and risk losing it for every attempted identity; an opal badge can simply display earned standing.
